title: Boom and Bust: Calgary's 1912 Land Rush and the 1913 Crash (Calgary Origins Ep 3)
script: Documentary about Calgary 1901-1955: a small prairie town grows tenfold, sandstone downtown buildings rise during a construction boom (Lougheed Building, library, Hudson's Bay store, Palliser Hotel), real estate offices, survey stakes and subdivision lot maps on empty prairie far from the city, a map of Calgary with communities, building permit bar charts, the 1913 crash with offices going dark, an oil well at Turner Valley in 1914, the First World War, tax arrears, empty lots waiting for decades, post-war suburbs built in the 1950s, downtown Calgary today with the 3D city and skyline.
